name: Container & Breakpoints
desc: Addition of xxl (1400px) breakpoint; fluid container width updates.

name: Grid System & Columns
desc: Row & column alignment, auto-margins, auto-layout columns, order utilities.

name: Gutters
desc: Complete removal of .no-gutters; introduction of .g-*, .gx-*, .gy-* gutter classes.

name: CSS Grid System
desc: Adoption of opt-in display: grid system (.grid, .g-col-*) alongside flexbox grid.

name: Reboot & Base HTML Reset
desc: CSS box-sizing reset, default body styling, native form element resets.

name: Typography & Headings
desc: Display headings (display-1..6), font-weight class updates, rem line-heights.

name: Code & Preformatted Text
desc: Code, kbd, pre, samp syntax styling adjustments and CSS variables.

name: Images
desc: Image responsive classes (.img-fluid, .img-thumbnail) and alignment utilities.

name: Tables
desc: Drop .thead-dark/light; update table variants (.table-*), borders with CSS vars.

name: Figures
desc: Figure and figure caption element alignment and spacing adjustments.

name: Alerts
desc: Replace legacy close button with .btn-close; update alert-heading and links.

name: Badges
desc: Replace .badge-pill with .rounded-pill; migrate contextual badges to .bg-* utilities.

name: Breadcrumb
desc: Divider customization moved to CSS custom property --bs-breadcrumb-divider.

name: Buttons & Button Groups
desc: Drop .btn-block (use .d-grid); update toggle button markup and active states.

name: Cards
desc: Remove card-deck and card-columns; convert multi-card views to grid .row-cols-*.

name: Carousel
desc: Update data attributes to data-bs-slide and data-bs-slide-to; dark variant, touch swipe.

name: Collapse
desc: Update data-bs-toggle="collapse"; migrate programmatic show/hide to native ES6 API.

name: Accordion
desc: Formal component rewrite from legacy card-collapse into dedicated .accordion-item markup.

name: Dropdowns
desc: Popper v2 integration; rename .dropleft/.dropright to .dropstart/.dropend; data-bs-toggle.

name: Modal
desc: Remove jQuery; migrate to bootstrap.Modal; replace dismiss icon with .btn-close; data-bs-*.

name: Navs & Tabs
desc: Migrate tab switching triggers to data-bs-toggle="tab"; update ARIA roles and tab content.

name: Navbar & Navigation
desc: Align internal container constraints; update toggler attributes and dark mode theme bindings.

name: Offcanvas
desc: New sidebar/drawer component; implement offcanvas-start/end/top/bottom with backdrop.

name: Pagination
desc: Spacing utilities alignment and focus ring CSS variable styling.

name: Placeholders / Skeletons
desc: New loading state animation component (.placeholder, .placeholder-glow).

name: Popovers
desc: Popper v2 placement keys, sanitizer options, native JS initialization.

name: Progress Bars
desc: Progress height and background customizations via CSS custom properties.

name: Scrollspy
desc: Update target selector attributes to data-bs-spy="scroll" and native refresh API.

name: Spinners
desc: Spinner border and grow animation utilities; button spinner placement.

name: Toasts
desc: Replace close button with .btn-close; native JS initialization; flex positioning container.

name: Tooltips
desc: Popper v2 configuration, DOM container placement, HTML sanitization rules.

name: Form Layout & Grouping
desc: Completely eliminate .form-group in favor of .mb-3; replace .form-row with .row.g-2.

name: Form Controls (Text/Inputs)
desc: Update input sizing, readonly plain text, color picker inputs, and datalists.

name: Floating Labels
desc: Implement native .form-floating wrappers across text fields and select dropdowns.

name: Select Controls
desc: Drop .custom-select in favor of unified native .form-select and sizes.

name: Checkboxes & Radios
desc: Drop .custom-checkbox and .custom-radio; migrate to unified .form-check and .form-check-input.

name: Switches
desc: Drop .custom-switch in favor of .form-check.form-switch.

name: File Browser
desc: Drop complex .custom-file markup; use standard .form-control[type=file].

name: Range Sliders
desc: Drop .custom-range; migrate to standard .form-range.

name: Input Groups
desc: Eliminate .input-group-prepend and .input-group-append; use direct child elements.

name: Form Validation
desc: Update client-side validation (.was-validated, .is-valid, .is-invalid, .valid-feedback).

name: Jumbotron (Dropped)
desc: Completely removed; refactor templates to utility padding/background containers.

name: Media Object (Dropped)
desc: Completely removed; refactor templates to native flexbox (.d-flex, .flex-shrink-0).

name: Card Decks & Columns (Dropped)
desc: Completely removed; refactor templates to responsive grid .row-cols-*.

name: Block Buttons (Dropped)
desc: Completely removed .btn-block; refactor templates to grid wrapper .d-grid.

name: Close Button (.btn-close)
desc: Standardize dismiss triggers across all components using standalone .btn-close.

name: Directional Spacing (ms/me/ps/pe)
desc: Universal codemod across templates: ml/mr -> ms/me, pl/pr -> ps/pe.

name: Directional Text & Floats
desc: Universal codemod: text-left/right -> text-start/end, float-left/right -> float-start/end.

name: Borders & Rounded Utilities
desc: Border-width, border-color CSS variables, .rounded-pill, .rounded-circle.

name: Colors & Backgrounds
desc: Contextual text/background utilities, opacity modifiers (.bg-opacity-*).

name: Display & Stacks
desc: Flex display utilities, introduction of vertical/horizontal stacks (.vstack, .hstack).

name: Embeds / Ratios
desc: Drop .embed-responsive; migrate to modern aspect-ratio helper .ratio and .ratio-16x9.

name: Position & Sizing
desc: Top/bottom/start/end position helpers, translate middle utilities, width/height percentages.

name: Visually Hidden Helper
desc: Drop legacy .sr-only and .sr-only-focusable; migrate to .visually-hidden.

name: jQuery De-coupling & Removal
desc: Complete removal of jQuery dependency; refactor custom scripts to vanilla ES6.

name: Native ES6 Component Lifecycle
desc: Migrate widget creation to bootstrap[Component].getOrCreateInstance(el).

name: Data Attribute Namespacing
desc: Universal template codemod updating data-* attributes to data-bs-* namespace.

name: Popper.js Engine Upgrade
desc: Migrate from Popper v1 to Popper Core v2, updating options and positioning logic.

name: CSS Custom Properties & Dark Mode
desc: Implement runtime theming via --bs-* variables and native data-bs-theme="dark".
